# tharsis_managed_identity (Resource)

Defines and manages a managed identity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tharsis_managed_identity" "aws" {
  name        = "my-aws-identity"
  description = "Federated AWS identity."
  type        = "aws_federated"
  group_id    = tharsis_group.top_level.id
  aws_role    = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/my-role"
}

# Azure and Tharsis identities use their own attributes instead of aws_role:
#
# resource "tharsis_managed_identity" "azure" {
#   name            = "my-azure-identity"
#   type            = "azure_federated"
#   group_id        = tharsis_group.top_level.id
#   azure_client_id = "<client_id>"
#   azure_tenant_id = "<tenant_id>"
# }
#
# resource "tharsis_managed_identity" "tharsis" {
#   name                         = "my-tharsis-identity"
#   type                         = "tharsis_federated"
#   group_id                     = tharsis_group.top_level.id
#   tharsis_service_account_path = "my-group/my-service-account"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the managed identity.
- `type` (String) Type of managed identity: AWS, Azure, or Tharsis.

### Optional

- `aws_role` (String) AWS role
- `azure_client_id` (String) Azure client ID
- `azure_tenant_id` (String) Azure tenant ID
- `description` (String) A description of the managed identity.
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the parent group.
- `group_path` (String, Deprecated) Full path of the parent group.
- `tharsis_service_account_path` (String) Tharsis service account path

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) String identifier of the managed identity.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp when this managed identity was most recently updated by Terraform.
- `resource_path` (String, Deprecated) The path of the parent group plus the name of the managed identity.
- `subject` (String) subject string for AWS, Azure, and Tharsis
